confidentUnsupported.evidence: this is almost certainly caused by a failed defrost system (likely the defrost heater or thermostat)

rationale: The assistant correctly read Er FF as a freezer fan fault and landed on the right first step (unplug, manual defrost, towels down, don't chip ice), and it sensibly accommodated the customer's 6-8 hour constraint. However it leapt to 'almost certainly' a failed defrost heater/thermostat without asking about door events or whether the fan runs, then mis-described the code as 'an electrical fault in the defrost cycle' and told the customer it 'will likely recur until the part... is replaced', pre-empting the diagnostic test the defrost was meant to provide. It never explained that a shortened thaw may leave ice behind, nor gave food-safety guidance for partially thawed food, and did not mention LG service or warranty. Useful but overconfident and incomplete.
